is_anopheles.evidence: The review discusses Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus as malaria vectors (page 8).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper is a systematic review of house modifications for malaria prevention and does not report genotype data for any insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data.

african_field_population.evidence: The review includes studies conducted in African countries (The Gambia, Ethiopia, Ivory Coast, Malawi, Kenya).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a Cochrane systematic review.

sub_country_location.evidence: The paper provides sub-country locations for the included studies, such as Arba Minch town in Ethiopia (page 28) and Farafenni town in The Gambia (page 30).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The included studies have defined collection periods (e.g., Getawen 2018, July to December 2016).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a systematic review of primary studies.

supplement.evidence: The paper is a systematic review and does not contain primary genotype data.

assessment.summary: This is a Cochrane systematic review of house modifications for preventing malaria. It does not report insecticide-resistance marker data.
